title: Context telemetry conflates cumulative work with prompt occupancy and directs premature session rotation
wanted_capability: Fleet should display measured last-request context occupancy rather than cumulative session input usage. Agent-facing status and documentation should describe occupancy as an observation, not a remaining session work budget or an instruction to stop assigning work: the harness can compact and continue. Existing Fleet footer sums result.usage across the session and divides by the compaction threshold; bro_status and bro_dashboard expose approaching_ceiling, and tool docs explicitly instruct rotation when it is true.
fallback_used: Use the harness context_pressure measurement and actual task blockers; do not interpret accumulated usage as remaining work capacity.
